1.consolidated_definition: Depósito de cadáveres. “Jaime Villegas Bou y don Francisco fueron llamados muchas veces por el necrocomio.”
1.en_consolidated_definition: Mortuary or charnel house; a place where corpses are deposited. "Jaime Villegas Bou and Don Francisco were often summoned by the mortuary."
